channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: The best looks from the 2026 Actors Awards red carpet
item.description: The best looks from the 2026 Actors Awards, previously known as the SAG Awards, include Chase Infiniti, Teyana Taylor, Kate Hudson, Gwyneth Paltrow and Kristen Bell.

item.title: Chad Baker-Mazara, USC's leading scorer, dismissed from men's basketball team
item.description: Sixth-year senior guard Chad Baker-Mazara, who spent most of this season as the Trojans' top scorer, was dismissed by the USC’s men’s basketball program Sunday.

item.title: Trump justifies Iran attack as Congress and others raise objections
item.description: President Trump justified attacking Iran without congressional approval by claiming the Iranian regime presented an 'imminent' threat to the U.S., which Democrats and some Republicans have questioned.

item.title: Flights from LAX to Middle East canceled amid Iran conflict
item.description: At LAX, airlines canceled some flights after several Middle East countries closed their airspace amid a widening conflict between the U.S., Israel and Iran.

item.title: 'Sinners,' Michael B. Jordan scramble Oscar race with 2026 Actor Awards wins
item.description: With motion picture ensemble and lead male actor prizes Sunday, 'Sinners' keeps its best picture hopes alive. Read our columnist's full analysis.

item.title: Inside El Mencho’s last hideout: Blood, bullets and a cartel boss' life of luxury
item.description: The aftermath of a Mexican special forces raid that killed the notorious leader of the Jalisco New Generation cartel offered a window into the life of a fugitive drug kingpin.

item.title: Who made the call to leave the Lachman fire? In sworn testimony, LAFD officials pass the buck
item.description: The testimony raises questions about why LAFD officials did not address concerns expressed to them about weather conditions and potentially dangerous hot spots that could flare up into another fire.

item.title: Iran’s ‘Axis of Resistance’: The proxy forces shaping Mideast conflicts
item.description: The far-flung militias represent crucial regional projections of Tehran’s power, emissaries from the Persian nation to conflict-ridden Arab countries.

item.title: Trump says more U.S. casualties likely after 3 American troops killed in escalating conflict with Iran
item.description: At least three U.S. service members are among hundreds killed in a widening war across the Middle East set off by U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran. President Trump said there will "likely" be more such casualties in coming weeks.

item.title: Thousands rally in Westwood as U.S.-Iran war escalates, calling for a 'free Iran'
item.description: Demonstrators gather outside the federal building in Westwood, the epicenter of L.A.'s sprawling Iranian diaspora, to celebrate the fall of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
